primary_structural_obligation.statement: For every accepted exact-DP transition on pivot x, Vars(F_after) is a subset of Vars(F_before) minus {x}; therefore V_after <= V_before-1. R33 and RUP introduce no new variables. Hence the number of outer exact-DP transitions along any route composed only of these operators is at most V_initial, and the number of R33/RUP phase segments is at most V_initial+1.

hierarchical_ranking_candidate.contract: Inside a fixed phase, AP requires strict Phi_phase descent on every successful R33/RUP transition. An outer exact-DP transition is allowed to reset Phi_phase but must strictly decrease the first coordinate V.
hierarchical_ranking_candidate.claim_scope: well-founded phase-count/progress ranking, not yet an end-to-end polynomial runtime theorem

frozen_global_scalar_attack.candidate: Gamma = L + (C_initial*V_initial+1)*V, with the weight frozen at the original formula root and applied across exact-DP transitions
frozen_global_scalar_attack.purpose: Determine whether the AP scalar itself can be extended globally without phase resets.

dp_explosion_gadget.construction: 8 positive pivot clauses share an 8-literal positive block and each has one unique positive marker; 8 negative pivot clauses share a disjoint 8-literal positive block and each has one unique positive marker. No SAT truth is used.

exact_dp_contract: deterministic random 3-CNF seeds 52000..52015 with n in {8,10} and fixed ratios in {2.5,3.0,3.5}
finite_audit_domain.sequential_dp_chain_rule: At each audit state choose the smallest bipolar variable and apply exact DP until no bipolar variable remains or V reaches zero. No truth is used.
finite_audit_domain.historical_hard_phase: AN raw child route with the AP R33/RUP phase audit, used only as a finite executable witness for the phase-local second coordinate.
